name: Disintegrate destroys a target ally
notes: Disintegrate's element is FIRE (matching the starting champion), so no lineage patch is needed. Dungeon Guide (an ALLY) is seeded onto the opponent's field as the target. Without the [Class Bonus] Efficiency discount, the full 8-reserve cost is paid, which needs more fuel than a natural hand provides, so 2 extra filler cards are seeded into hand alongside Disintegrate. Being an ALLY (not an ITEM/WEAPON), the destroyed target resolves to its owner's graveyard, matching the ally-routing behavior noted in meltdown-level2-destroy-item's DoAllyDestroyed/DoSacrificeFighter chain, unlike break-apart-destroy's plain-ITEM target which also went to graveyard.
